newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lankan rupee again closes at new low vs dlr.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lankan rupee again closes at new low vs dlr.

text.p: Import covering pushed down the Sri Lankan rupee to a new closing low of 56.97 to the dollar on Friday, dealers said.
This compares with the rupee's previous closing low of 56.95 set on Thursday.
"Serious import covering emerged around mid-day by a state bank and a foreign bank, pushing down the rupee," said a Standard Chartered Bank dealer.
The rupee hit an all-time low of 57 to the dollar before recovering slightly on profit-taking by the state Bank of Ceylon, he said.
The rupee moved in a tight 56.94-57.00 range for the whole of Friday, dealers said.
The Central Bank left the dollar-rupee exchange rate unchanged, fixing its buying and selling rates at 55.9226 and 57.0524.
The overnight call money rate closed at 17 percent after opening at 16.5 pecent as banks prepared for weekend cash withdrawals by their clients, dealers said.
